method.one_loop_functional: W_1 = (1/2) sum_n (1/n) Tr[(P V)^n] for the A sector and -(1/2) sum_n (1/n) Tr[(P V)^n] for the lambda sector and for the odd pair (c, A^*|_V), with P the Wick contraction values of P(eps,infty) and V the matrix of the background-field quadratic part of I (written 1/2 X^T V X); for two external lambda legs: one-loop quadratic form 1/2 lambda^T <Y G Y> lambda with background-corrected lambda and A lines
method.propagators_rederived: A-A: 2 (-,-)^{-1} e^{-eps p^2}/p^2 (inverse of the Feynman-gauge form of -1/4(dA,dA)); lambda-lambda: i (-,-)^{-1} rho(p) e^{-eps p^2}/p^2 (= (-K)^{-1} for 1/2 lambda^T K lambda); c-A^*|_V and A^*|_V-c: -i (-,-)^{-1} p e^{-eps p^2}/p^2 (pseudo-inverse of (dc,A^*)); all agree with classical_spec section 7
method.log_eps: exact: the log eps coefficient of int d^4k/(2pi)^4 F with every line cut off by e^{-eps k_e^2} is -(1/(16 pi^2)) x (S^3 average of the degree -4 part of the large-k expansion of F); expansion in the external momenta done exactly (polynomial-matrix algebra, dyadic floats converted to Fractions, S^3 moments as exact rationals)
method.T2_route: renormalised self-energy route: exact Schwinger evaluation of every A|_V two-point graph with t_e in [eps,infty) (incomplete-Gamma closed form, exact eps -> 0 expansion, Euler constant and log 2 kept symbolic), longitudinal and transverse polarisations; obstruction = Q of the local longitudinal part, because Q of the transverse part and Q of the (c,A^*) two-point vanish in the (c,A|_V) sector ((dc, d^*dA) integrates to 0)
method.configurations: T1: 20 random integer configurations, entries in [-9,9]; every per-class ratio identical at all 20 (a residual structure of degree <= 4 vanishes at a random point with probability <= 4/19). T2: p along a basis axis with colour t_1, and p = (1/2,1/2,1/2,1/2) with colour t_2; identical results
